lead.question: 一个视力正常的11岁女孩，为何能用手和皮肤“看见”东西？
lead.warmup: 科幻小说里常有人仅凭皮肤就能“看见”颜色、看穿墙壁的情节。俄罗斯最近就报道了一系列这样的真实案例，其中最引人注目的，是一位名叫维拉·彼托洛娃的11岁女孩。她视力完全正常，却能用手、肘、脚甚至肩膀辨认物体。这项被称作“第二视觉”的奇特能力究竟是怎样被发现的？先听录音，从课文中找出答案。
goals: 掌握 detect、perceive、sensitive、opaque、blindfold、cease 等核心词汇的用法。
理解并运用被动语态：have been reported / was given / was noticed by。
学会用 who 引导的定语从句准确描述人物及其特征。
能用英文复述维拉的“第二视觉”以及她在科研测试中的表现。
lead.summary: 课文讲述了俄罗斯女孩维拉·彼托洛娃的奇特能力：她视力正常，却能凭皮肤的不同部位辨认物体，甚至透过厚墙。她父亲偶然发现后，科研机构对她进行了一系列测试——隔着不透明屏幕读报、用肘部和脚识别纸牌与图画。但实验表明，只有当双眼被蒙住时这种能力才存在，而且双手一湿，能力便立即消失。
lead.tips: 注意 the moment 引导时间状语从句，相当于 as soon as，意为“一……就……”；另外主句为过去时，宾语从句须用过去时，别误用现在时，如 her hands were wet 不能写成 are wet。

questions.q: How did Vera discover she had this gift of second sight?
questions.zh: 维拉是怎样发现自己拥有这种“第二视觉”天赋的？
questions.a: Her father first noticed the ability when, one day in his office, she happened to put her hands on the door of a locked safe and suddenly asked why he kept so many old newspapers locked away there, even describing how they were done up in bundles.
questions.aZh: 是她父亲首先发现了这一能力：一天她在父亲办公室，偶然把手放在锁着的保险柜门上，突然问父亲为什么把这么多旧报纸锁在里面，还描述了报纸捆扎的样子。
questions.hint: 见课文第3至第5句（This ability was first noticed by her father ... done up in bundles）。

questions.q: What did Vera do one day in her father's office?
questions.zh: 一天维拉在父亲的办公室里做了什么？
questions.a: She came into his office and happened to put her hands on the door of a locked safe. Suddenly she asked her father why he kept so many old newspapers locked away there, and even described the way they were done up in bundles.
questions.aZh: 她走进父亲办公室，偶然把手放在一个锁着的保险柜门上，突然问父亲为什么把这么多旧报纸锁在里面，还描述了那些报纸捆扎的形状。

questions.q: What could Vera do during the series of tests?
questions.zh: 在一系列测试中，维拉都能做些什么？
questions.a: She was able to read a newspaper through an opaque screen; by moving her elbow over a child's game of Lotto she could describe the figures and colours printed on it; and, wearing stockings and slippers, she could make out with her foot the outlines and colours of a picture hidden under a carpet.
questions.aZh: 她能隔着不透明屏幕读报纸；把肘部在儿童“罗托”纸牌上移动，便能说出上面的数字和颜色；还穿着长筒袜和拖鞋，用脚辨认出藏在地毯下一幅画的轮廓和颜色。
questions.hint: 见课文第6句（During these tests ... under a carpet）。

questions.q: What conditions affected Vera's ability to perceive things?
questions.zh: 哪些条件会影响维拉辨认物体的能力？
questions.a: She lacked the ability to perceive things with her skin except when she was blindfold; and even with her fingers the ability ceased the moment her hands were wet.
questions.aZh: 除了蒙上双眼时，她无法用皮肤辨认物体；而且即便用手，手指一旦弄湿，这种功能也会立刻消失。
questions.hint: 见课文最后两句（except when blindfold ... her hands were wet）。

questions.q: Do you think Vera's 'second sight' was real? What might explain it?
questions.zh: 你认为维拉的“第二视觉”是真实的吗？它可能是什么原因造成的？
questions.a: It might have been genuine skin sensitivity that most people never develop, or the tests may not have been strict enough and she could somehow see through the blindfold. Either way, the case shows how carefully scientists must design experiments to rule out trickery.
questions.aZh: 这也许是她真有一种常人未开发的皮肤感知能力，也许测试不够严密，她能设法从蒙眼中偷看。无论如何，这个案例说明科学家必须精心设计实验，才能排除作弊的可能。
questions.hint: 开放题，可从“真实能力”与“测试漏洞”两方面作答。

exercises.q: 俄罗斯最近报道了几个事例，有人能用手指辨认颜色。
exercises.a: Several cases have been reported in Russia recently of people who can detect colours with their fingers.
exercises.note: 现在完成时的被动语态

exercises.q: Her father first noticed this ability.（改为被动语态）
exercises.a: This ability was first noticed by her father.

exercises.q: In April she ___ (give) a series of tests by a special commission.
改错：It was found that although she could perceive things with her fingers this ability ceased the moment her hands are wet.
exercises.note: 主句过去时，从句须一致

exercises.q: 只有蒙住双眼时，她才能用指尖辨认物体。
exercises.a: Only when she was blindfolded could she perceive things with her fingertips.

exercises.q: Other experiments showed that her knees and shoulders had a similar ___ (sensitive).
One case concerns an eleven-year-old schoolgirl. She has normal vision.（用 who 合并为一句）
exercises.a: One case concerns an eleven-year-old schoolgirl who has normal vision.

quiz.q: 维拉的特异功能最早是由谁发现的？
options: A commission of the Ministry of Health.
quiz.note: This ability was first noticed by her father.

quiz.q: 在实验中，当维拉被蒙上双眼时，她能用皮肤做什么？
options: She could perceive things with her skin.
She lost all ability at once.
She could see nothing at all.
quiz.note: 蒙眼时她才有皮肤辨物能力。

quiz.q: 她的手一旦弄湿，会发生什么？
options: She could still use her feet.
quiz.note: the ability ceased the moment her hands were wet.

quiz.q: 测试中维拉隔着什么读报纸？
quiz.note: read a newspaper through an opaque screen。

quiz.q: 实验表明她的膝盖和肩膀怎样？
options: They had no sensitivity at all.
quiz.note: knees and shoulders had a similar sensitivity.

quiz.q: 维拉用什么部位在儿童“罗托”纸牌上辨认数字和颜色？
quiz.note: by moving her elbow over a game of Lotto。
